$comment: Machine-readable mirror of ai-state/SELECTIONS.md — the AI's persistent choice registry (style sheets, skills, MCP per project). Update BOTH files together: SELECTIONS.md is the human/AI-readable source of truth, selections.json is for automated tooling.

protocol.reuseExistingEntry: If an entry exists for the project/page, reuse its style/skills/MCP choices exactly. Do not re-pick.
protocol.writeBeforeCode: If no entry exists, choose via ../README.md workflows, then append an entry BEFORE coding.
protocol.userOverride: Log replaced choices in the entry's 'replacedDecisions' field.
protocol.noDeletion: Entries are never deleted: status flows in-progress -> done | abandoned.
